name: QUT Asylum Seeker Tuition Fee Scholarship
summary: A full tuition fee waiver plus an equity scholarship for asylum seekers starting a QUT undergraduate degree.
key: A full tuition fee waiver, plus a guaranteed Equity Scholarship of $2,100 (2024 terms).
who: Starting a university undergraduate degree for the first time.
Hold a Bridging Visa E (050), Temporary Protection Visa (785) or Safe Haven Enterprise Visa (790).
Accepted into a QUT undergraduate degree.
how: Apply with the application form, with evidence of visa status, your financial situation and a financial impact statement.
catches: The terms found are from 2024. QUT runs a 2026 application form, so check the current round.

source.label: QUT: Asylum Seeker Tuition Fee Scholarship

evidence.quote: The Scholarship recipient will receive a guaranteed Equity Scholarship to the value of $2100 for Semester 2, 2024.
